class.name: AudioStreamFLAC
class.description: FLAC audio stream driver. See [member data] if you want to load an FLAC file at run-time.

method.name: load_from_buffer
method.description: Creates a new [AudioStreamFLAC] instance from the given buffer. The buffer must contain FLAC data.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Creates a new [AudioStreamFLAC] instance from the given file path. The file must be in FLAC format.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the stream will automatically loop when it reaches the end.
Time in seconds at which the stream starts after being looped.

Contains user-defined tags if found in the FLAC data. Commonly used tags include [code]title[/code], [code]artist[/code], [code]album[/code], [code]tracknumber[/code], and [code]date[/code] ([code]date[/code] does not have a standard date format). [b]Note:[/b] No tag is [i]guaranteed[/i] to be present in every file, so make sure to account for the keys not always existing.
